intro: Work through an integrated reading of informative documents, an opinion and a fact subject to a condition. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

texto: Work through an integrated reading of informative documents, an opinion and a fact subject to a condition. Tell apart claims, evidence and reservations; attribute each piece of data to its source before drawing a conclusion.
Watch out: summarise without erasing the reservations: separate what has been decided, what is proposed and what depends on a later assessment. In this passage, «réserve» means «reservation».

frases.estudio: Le conseil a voté la rénovation de la gare, mais le calendrier définitif dépend encore de l'appel d'offres.
frases.alumno: The council voted for the renovation of the station, but the final schedule still depends on the public tender.

frases.estudio: La note technique prévoit une fermeture partielle de six mois et recommande de maintenir un accès aux quais.
frases.alumno: The technical note forecasts a six-month partial closure and recommends keeping access to the platforms.

frases.estudio: Une association de voyageurs soutient le projet, tout en demandant une solution pour les personnes à mobilité réduite.
frases.alumno: A travellers' association supports the project, but asks for a solution for people with reduced mobility.

frases.estudio: Le financement est annoncé sous réserve d'une évaluation des coûts, qui sera publiée avant la fin de l'année.
frases.alumno: Funding has been announced subject to a cost assessment, which will be published before the end of the year.
